simple.meaning: אֲרַמִּי (ʼĂrammîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “an Aramite or Aramaean.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֲרַמִּי (H761) appears 11 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 25:20, with occurrences in Genesis, Deuteronomy, 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֲרַמִּי (H761) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֲרַמִּי (H761) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֲרַמִּי (ʼĂrammîy) / H761 is traced through Genesis 25:20, Genesis 28:5, Genesis 31:20, Genesis 31:24 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
